mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals monetary tightening, reducing corporate investment and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a strong labor market and robust household demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and RSAFS increase fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals an impending slowdown in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered instances during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong household demand, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a contractionary economic environment and monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO decline and FEDFUNDS rise fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a further rise in unemployment signals a deepening labor market crisis, reducing consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered instances during high-unemployment regimes, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
